messages:
lina: Noticing a cluster-wide decrypt error in eu-west-1 during node boot, multiple GPUs failing to mount model volumes.
rahul: seeing same. Agent logs: `kms.Decrypt failed: AccessDenied` followed by `mount timeout`.
michael: any recent KMS or egress changes? I didn't get alerts earlier.
security-bot: Policy Change: applied prefix-list-refactor to vpc-prod-eu (by security-ci). Note: replaced hardcoded CIDRs with managed prefix-list 'PL-INFRA-01'.
ops-bot: Alert: 24 nodes failed to finish boot due to keystore/kms access issues in eu-west-1b.
lina: pinging network team: does PL-INFRA-01 include the keystore and KMS proxy ranges? It seems decryption is blocked.
rahul: quick test from a broken node: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://keystore.internal/v1/session` -> 403
michael: found the mismatch: PL-INFRA-01 references an older managed list id that doesn't contain 10.48.200.0/24 (keystore) — change PR swapped IDs but not contents.
lina: impact: warm-pool down 40% in eu-west-1, model mounts fail, traffic fell back to regional cache replicas and CPU inference nodes.
rahul: mitigation options: 1) roll back prefix-list change 2) append keystore/KMS CIDRs to PL-INFRA-01 3) add explicit allow for keystore subnet. Prefer minimal blast: append missing CIDRs.
michael: I'll open CR and include a canary rollout to one AZ first. Also adding a preflight check to validate managed prefix list contents against our "egress service registry".
ops-bot: Change Request CR#3301 opened by michael. Rollout: immediate canary eu-west-1a.
security-bot: Prefix-list updated: PL-INFRA-01 now includes 10.48.200.0/24 and 10.48.201.0/24. Change id pl-update-3301.
lina: retesting from stuck node: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://keystore.internal/v1/ping` -> 200
rahul: nodes starting to complete boot, warm-pool shows +32% within 2m.
michael: postmortem notes: root cause was replacing explicit CIDRs with a managed prefix list whose contents weren't verified. Action items: 1) add prefix-list content verification in change pipeline 2) publish mapping of critical services to CIDRs and prefix-lists 3) runbook for prefix-list rollbacks.
ops-bot: Action created ENG-SRE-3302 to implement prefix-list preflight checks; owner rahul.
lina: finance note: can we estimate cost delta for regional fallback and Cache egress in the 25m window? rough guess ~450 USD.
rahul: assigning follow-ups and closing thread once ENG-SRE-3302 is started. Thanks all for quick patch.
